brief:
Muammar al-Uweiwi gathered his family's identification documents and clothing in predawn darkness as Israeli soldiers ordered an immediate evacuation from his Hebron home, the Palestine News Network reported. The commands echoed through the area as residents faced sudden displacement.

The incident is part of a broader pattern affecting multiple families in Hebron, forcing residents to abandon their homes with minimal warning and few possessions.

title: Israeli evacuation order displaces Hebron families from homes
